title: [CI] Run TVM backend tests in dynamo_core shard
body:
## Why

- The tvm backend tests in `test/dynamo/test_backends.py` are permanently skipped because CI never installs `apache-tvm`, so the in-tree tvm backend has no CI coverage

## How

- Installs a pinned `apache-tvm` wheel in the `dynamo_core` shard
